resources.string: Encrypted local snapshots of new messages received by this client. Telegram messages and update state remain unchanged.
Off by default. When enabled, only chats listed below are archived. Secret, disappearing, one-time and forwarding-protected content is always excluded.
No chats selected. Enabling the switch alone archives nothing.
Stop automatic archiving in every chat? Existing local snapshots remain until removed from Memory.

Automatic retention: up to 400 messages for 90 days within the 500-card and 256 MB account limits. Manual Memory cards have priority. Already downloaded originals up to 8 MB may be retained; MOROK never starts a media download.
Explicitly copies up to 100 recent messages already present in Telegram’s local cache. It does not request older messages or download media. The same exclusions and 90-day automatic retention apply.
Import up to 100 recent locally cached messages from %1$s into encrypted Memory?
Retained %1$d of %2$d eligible messages found among %3$d local records.
The local cache could not be imported. Check the active account, free space and the Memory encryption key.
